Container.Name: VergissMeinNicht
Container.Overview: Shared checklists for the routines you repeat — with a history you can trust. Invite-only, optional two-factor, works offline on phones. Needs HTTPS: use Unraid's Tailscale with Serve (or a reverse proxy). Guide: docu/unraid.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, its WAL files and backups. Sensitive: keep it private (0700, owned by 99:100).

Config.Name: Secrets
Config.Description: Folder with the files auth_secret and data_encryption_key (and smtp_password if needed).

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The HTTPS address people open: https://vergissmeinnicht.YOUR-TAILNET.ts.net (Tailscale Serve) — no path, no trailing slash.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: loopback with Tailscale Serve inside the container (it forwards from 127.0.0.1). With a reverse proxy: its fixed IP.

Config.Name: Run as user id
Config.Description: The application runs as this user (Unraid: 99 = nobody). Never 0.

Config.Name: Run as group id
Config.Description: The application runs as this group (Unraid: 100 = users). Never 0.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server for invitations and account recovery.

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: Leave empty if your mail server needs no login. With a user: put the password into the file secrets/smtp_password and fill in SMTP password file below.

Config.Name: SMTP password file
Config.Description: Only with an SMTP user: /run/secrets/smtp_password (the file secrets/smtp_password in appdata). Leave empty without a user.

Config.Name: Sender address
Config.Description: From address of the emails, e.g. noreply@example.org.

Config.Name: Backups every (hours)
Config.Description: Automatic verified backups into Data/backups. 0 = off.

Config.Name: Migrate on start
Config.Description: Apply database updates when the container starts (a backup is written first).
